thread:
Sam: Heads-up — vendor flagged 6 H100s DOA from the APAC allotment. Vendor proposes partial RMA + staggered replacements. Need quick decision on routing and cost split. Thoughts?
Maria: ugh. which warehouse/awb? any customs holds? :worried: 
Sam: Vendor AWB 8472-APX; currently at FRA broker hold per vendor note. They can either air-expedite replacements from their EU pool (ETA 48h) or reship cross-regional from APAC (ETA ~7d). Partial replace would ship 3 now, 3 after QA.
Eve (vendor-nexasupply): confirmed — we can do 3x air now + 3x sea later. Air surcharge ~€1,200/unit. We can absorb 50% of expedite fee if Redwood covers the remainder and returns DOA units within 14 days.
Alex: If we take air now, we need a staging plan for EU. Do we have spare racks? Also: onboarding tickets must block production until serial verification completes.
Maria: we have 4 spare slots in AMS staging, can accept 3. Need ~1h dock window and customs release — I can triage with forwarder.
Jitendra (Finance): confirm the math. If surcharge €1,200 and we take 50% + brokerage €300, net per-unit = €900? Need approval.
Eve: math checks. Vendor covers €600/unit, Redwood covers €600 + €300 brokerage = €900/unit. APAC reship has €0 surcharge but 7d delay and extra borrow cost for loaners.
Sam: ops risk: delayed capacity affects scheduled Dedicated training in APAC — estimated lost throughput ~ $12k/day for 3 days on the workflows pinned to those slots. Air might be cost-effective overall.
Alex: leaning air. Also request vendor provide temporary loaners for non-prod. Eve, can you confirm loaner terms and availability?
Eve: we have 2 loaners available immediately; loaners free up to 10 days with LOA and pre-label return AWB. Will need a signed loaner addendum.
Maria: I'll own customs/clearance. @Eve please ensure invoice matches PO 47821 and includes itemized brokerage line so customs doesn't bounce it.
Sam: DOA serials: H100-APX-2219, H100-APX-2220, H100-APX-2221 (DOA batch). PO 47821 PDF will be dropped in #vendors thread.
Jitendra: finance can approve covering €900/unit for expedite + brokerage, contingent on vendor email confirming they cover other 50% and loaner addendum.
Eve: will send a signed cost-share confirmation and the loaner addendum by EOD.
Logistics-Bot: AWB 8472-APX status: "Customs Hold - Documentation Requested". ETA to clear once docs received: 6-12 hours.
Maria: sending docs now. @Eve pls confirm invoice updated and mailed to maria@redwood.com
Eve: invoice updated and sent to maria@redwood.com — includes PO and brokerage line.
Alex: onboarding ops: once loaner arrives, tag and restrict to non-prod. Commands:
```
./inventory tag H100-LOAN-01 temp-loaner
./inventory restrict H100-LOAN-01 non-prod
```
Sam: agreed. Maria — confirm dock window after clearance; Alex will schedule an onboarding freeze until serial validation complete.
Maria: dock window booked for tonight 22:00-23:00 CET if clearance finishes. I'll update thread.
Sam: final call: accept air partial replace + loaners, Redwood covers €900/unit expedite/brokerage, vendor covers rest and supplies loaners with addendum. Proceeding unless objections within 30m.
Jitendra: approved (finance).
Alex: approved (infra).
Eve: documents sent and will trigger release on receipt.
Logistics-Bot: AWB 8472-APX status changed to "Released to Forwarder" at 1719923480.
Maria: received release, moving to dock prep. Thanks team :thumbsup:
